fields.meta_title: Leave Approval Workflow With Balance Checks | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a leave approval workflow that checks the balance, flags team overlaps, sends long leave to HR, and approves same-day sick calls.
fields.h1: Build a Leave Approval Workflow Around Balances and Coverage
fields.hero_description: Get a leave approval workflow that checks each request against the balance and the team calendar before a manager decides.
fields.features_heading: What the App Checks Before Anyone Approves
fields.features_subheading: Describe your leave types and who signs off. Emergent builds the app that holds the balances and routes each request.
fields.feature_1:
Leave policy written as you say it

Write the policy as HR explains it: 15 vacation days, 5 sick days, HR signs anything over 10 days. Emergent builds the request form and rules from that, and edits both by prompt.
fields.feature_2:
Balances by person and leave type

The app keeps a balance for each employee and leave type. Approved days come off when the manager signs, a canceled request puts them back, and it all sits in a database you own.
fields.feature_3:
Who is out, shown next to the request

A manager opening a request sees the team calendar for those dates on the same screen. Two names already out that Friday tell the manager more than the request alone.
fields.feature_4:
Nudges when a request sits

Set how long a request may wait. The app sends the approver a Slack or email reminder after 2 days and escalates to the next approver on day 3, so no request sits unread.
fields.feature_5:
Approved leave lands in your other tools

The app connects to any tool with an API. An approval can post the dates to the shared calendar and update the employee record in your HR system, with no dates copied by hand.
fields.feature_6:
Every decision on the record

Each request keeps its dates, the balance at the time, the approver, the decision, and any comment. Add every manager who approves leave, since there are no per-approver seats.

fields.tab_content_1:
5 days asked with 3 in the balance

Quillon Ravensberg wants a full week off in June, but his vacation balance shows 3 days. The form shows the 2-day shortfall before he submits, and any days past the balance go in as unpaid. His manager, Odessa Prewitt, gets one request: 3 vacation days and 2 unpaid.
fields.tab_content_2:
Third agent out? The manager sees it first

Two of the six support agents are already off on May 14 and 15 when Marisol Lindqvist asks for both days. Her request reaches her manager, Teodor Vance, with a flag: she would be the third agent out at once, and the rule allows 2. He decides with the team calendar open.
fields.tab_content_3:
12 days off needs HR and the manager

Benedikt Amara plans a long trip and requests 12 working days. Anything over 10 days needs a second signature. His manager, Saoirse Delmont, approves first, and the request then goes to Ignatius Bell in HR. The days come off his balance only when Ignatius signs.
fields.tab_content_4:
No waiting on a sick call at 7:40

Philippa Narang wakes up sick and logs 1 sick day from her phone at 7:40. A single sick day needs no approval under the rule. The app approves it on submission, and her sick balance drops from 5 days to 4. Her manager, Casimir Thorne, gets a message that she is out today.

fields.howto_title: How to Build a Leave Approval Workflow
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to turn your leave policy into a leave approval workflow that checks balances and coverage before anyone approves.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Export a year of leave requests
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 List each leave type and its allowance
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Set a coverage limit for each team
fields.howto_step_1_des: Export last year's leave requests to one sheet with the dates, leave type, approver, and how many days each one waited. Mark the requests that were approved and later canceled.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write down every leave type with its yearly allowance and whether unused days carry over. Note which types need a manager's approval and which, like a single sick day, do not.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide what happens when a request is longer than the balance: block it, file the extra days as unpaid, or send it to HR. Every later rule reads that balance.
fields.howto_step_4_des: For each team, write how many people may be out on the same day, and name the person who decides a request that goes past the limit.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste the leave types, the balance rule, the coverage limits, and the approvers into one prompt. Emergent builds the request form, the balances, the routing, and the manager's view.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Run 10 requests from your busiest month through the app. Compare each outcome with what your managers decided, and change any rule that disagrees by prompting.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Open the app to one team for a month. Then load every employee's opening balance and invite the rest of the company.

faq_plan.q: What is a leave approval workflow?
faq_plan.a: A leave approval workflow is the path a time-off request takes from the employee to a decision. The employee picks the leave type and dates, the app compares it with the days left and with who else is off, the right approver says yes or no, and the balance updates once it is approved.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a leave approval workflow?
faq_plan.a: Write down your leave types, allowances, and who approves what, then describe them in a prompt to Emergent's AI automation builder. Emergent turns that into one app: a form for employees, a screen for managers, and the rules between them. Test it on a month of old requests before you open it to the team.

faq_plan.q: What should the request form in a leave approval workflow ask for?
faq_plan.a: Ask for the leave type, the first and last day, and whether either end is a half day. Add an optional note for the approver. Show the employee's current balance for that leave type on the form itself. A request that runs past it is then caught before submit, not after a manager reads it.

faq_plan.q: Can I reuse a leave approval workflow for other kinds of requests?
faq_plan.a: Yes, the chain itself carries over: manager first, then a second approver past a threshold. What changes is the threshold. Leave routes on the number of days. A budget approval workflow routes on the amount instead. Give each its own rules, even when the same managers approve both.

faq_plan.q: How does a leave approval workflow track half days?
faq_plan.a: Store balances in hours or in half-day units instead of whole days. A balance of 7.5 days then holds up when someone takes Friday afternoon off, and the form can offer morning or afternoon on the first and last day of any request.

faq_plan.q: What should a leave approval workflow do when approved leave is canceled?
faq_plan.a: Return only the days that have not been taken yet. If someone cancels the last 2 days of a 5-day trip on day 3, put those 2 back and keep the 3 already used. Keep the canceled request on file with its original approval. The history then still matches the balance.

faq_plan.q: Can a leave approval workflow have more than one approver?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Set a sequence, such as the manager first and HR second for anything over 10 days, or ask for two approvals at once when someone reports to a line manager and a project lead. A contract approval workflow uses the same sequence with legal and finance in place of HR. Add every approver you need, since the app has no per-approver seats.

faq_plan.q: How much notice should a leave approval workflow require?
faq_plan.a: Pick a notice period per leave type and put it in the rules, for example 2 weeks for vacation and none for sick days. The form can then warn anyone asking for vacation next Monday, and you decide whether a late request is blocked or sent to the manager with a note.

faq_plan.q: How do I add blackout dates to a leave approval workflow?
faq_plan.a: List the dates per team, such as a year-end close or a product launch week, and have the form stop vacation requests that touch them. Leave sick days outside the block. Because Emergent builds the app from a prompt, adding next year's dates is one sentence, not a settings hunt.

faq_plan.q: Can employees see where their request is in a leave approval workflow?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Give each employee a page listing their requests with the current step, the approver it waits on, and the decision once made. A content approval workflow gives writers the same view of each draft. The app Emergent builds keeps every request and decision in a database you own.

plan.angle: The top results are vendor setup guides and forum threads that treat a leave approval workflow as a form that emails a manager. This page builds the four checks that decide whether a leave request should be approved at all: the balance the request draws on, who else on the team is already off those dates, how long the absence runs, and whether it is a same-day sick call that cannot wait for a reply. Timesheet sign-off, pay runs and generic routing belong to the timesheet approval, payroll automation and approval workflow pages; this page stays on leave requests, balances and coverage.
